role: TileEntitySpecialRenderer for TileEntityChest: draws the ModelChest or ModelLargeChest (single or double, normal/trapped/christmas textures), rotates by the block metadata facing, and opens the lid from the interpolated field_145989_m lid angle (cubic ease, taking the max over coupled double-chest halves).

members.name: field_147507_b, field_147508_c, field_147505_d, field_147506_e, field_147503_f, field_147504_g
members.note: normal, normal_double, trapped and trapped_double as vanilla picks them; the christmas pair is field_147509_j's

members.name: field_147509_j
members.note: the christmas flag reads the machine's wall clock when the renderer is made (Calendar.getInstance, not the oracle's calendar pin, which covers World.theCalendar only), so a golden's chest texture follows the day it was recorded, not the game; the native draws the normal textures, as every golden made outside Dec 24 to 26 does

members.name: TileEntityChestRenderer
members.note: the models; the wall-clock flag is field_147509_j's

notes: raster_tileent.c ports the whole draw: the single or double model from the adjacent chests (a double chest draws once, from the half with no z- or x- neighbour), the facing rotation and the two double-chest offsets, the lid's cubic ease from lidAngle and prevLidAngle, GL_RESCALE_NORMAL. te_chests and te_dungeon record chests opened and closed by the player (the lid over frames with the GUI up and falling after), double and trapped chests at several facings: every view within its budget with no pxdiff cluster. The lid state itself steps natively (raster_tileents_lid_tick, test_rendertick section 6). lane/idxclient: the christmas flag is a wall-clock read outside the game state (see field_147509_j).
